page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.large is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration featuring 4 vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio. The instance runs on the x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. With two physical cores and two threads per core under KVM virtualization, the underlying hardware provides 35 MB of shared L3 cache, along with vector and cryptographic instruction support including AVX, AVX-512, and AES-NI.

Benchmark testing reflects modest computing throughput characteristic of older hardware tiers. The instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 873.0 and a multi-core score of 2768.0, placing its raw compute within the lower quartile of modern cloud benchmarks. Multi-threaded decompression and compression tests, such as bzip3 and gzip, similarly indicate constrained throughput. However, memory subsystem testing demonstrates competent performance, reaching uncached large-block write bandwidth of 28.16 GB/sec.

The ecs.n2.large includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent data. It does not provide hardware GPU acceleration or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the balanced ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU suits workloads that do not justify premium modern compute architectures, though users must account for the lower per-core compute speeds.

This server instance fits moderate general-purpose tasks where extreme processing speeds are secondary to baseline memory availability. Practical deployments include development and staging environments, lightweight application tiers, background task processing, low-traffic static web servers, and distributed microservices with predictable resource demands.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.large is a general-purpose server instance configured with 4 vCPUs and 16.0 GB of RAM, adhering to a 1:4 core-to-memory ratio. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, the machine relies on two physical cores with multithreading and KVM virtualization. The system includes 35 MB of L3 cache, AVX-512 instructions, and AES acceleration. Hardware benchmarks position this instance in the entry-to-moderate performance range, highlighted by a Geekbench multi-core score of 2768.0, PassMark CPU score of 5201.76, and write memory bandwidth of 28.16 GB/sec. The instance lacks onboard local disk storage and contains no discrete GPUs. Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.large is designed for general utility tasks, internal development environments, light web traffic serving, and balanced non-intensive business applications.
